issues.title: Health Bar should be centered under MilSymbol, not whole element
issues.body:
When we have symbol labels switch on, the element becomes wider.

This pushes the `health bar` over to the right.

![screencase](https://i.gyazo.com/0c2e9716b290805d28dbc4fd7894d330.gif)

I _guess_ we need to position it an absolute number of pixels over from the left of the composite symbol, rather than the centre of the composite symbol.

But, there could be alternate solutions too.
